name: Chipz
description: Chipz is the VRChat roleplay persona of streamer StealthRG, portrayed as a nightclub owner whose character arc shifted from human to vampire over the course of long-running community storylines. He led his own venue through the [Chipz Night Club RP Collective](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Chipz_Night_Club_RP_collective) and was a central figure in large-scale community roleplay events such as [The Crossover](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/The_Crossover), alongside other well-known VRChat personas.
